# [\#14 Issue](https://github.com/dEhiN/CanadianBusinessCollege--FullStackWebApplicationDiploma/issues/14) `closed`: Research more into the directory structure Gemini suggested

#### <img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/26848686?u=6c1f8b72ff786312cb5de7ffb1fbb1a9b8f2b464&v=4" width="50">[dEhiN](https://github.com/dEhiN) opened issue at [2026-05-24 04:52](https://github.com/dEhiN/CanadianBusinessCollege--FullStackWebApplicationDiploma/issues/14):

The following structure was recommended for splitting up `server.js`:

```
├── .env
├── server.js             # The entry point (orchestrates startup)
├── config/
│   └── db.js             # Mongoose database connection setup
├── middleware/
│   └── validateSchema.js # Custom Ajv validation middleware
├── models/
│   ├── User.js           # Mongoose User Schema & Model
│   └── Trip.js           # Mongoose Trip Schema & Model
└── routes/
    ├── userRoutes.js     # Express routes for user accounts
    └── tripRoutes.js     # Express routes for booking/history
```

#### <img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/26848686?u=6c1f8b72ff786312cb5de7ffb1fbb1a9b8f2b464&v=4" width="50">[dEhiN](https://github.com/dEhiN) commented at [2026-05-25 09:16](https://github.com/dEhiN/CanadianBusinessCollege--FullStackWebApplicationDiploma/issues/14#issuecomment-4533090362):

This structure was set up, but `db.js` was ignored in favour of keeping the DB connection code in `server.js`. The other directories and files were created.
